Step 0: Load Packages and Environment
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  caret,
  pROC,
  PRROC,
  keras3,
  tensorflow
)

set.seed(42)
tensorflow::set_random_seed(42)

```


Step 1: Load data
```{r} 
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/USER/Desktop/data_set_2_kaggle.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

str(df)
dim(df)

# Target
df$FraudFound <- ifelse(df$FraudFound == "Yes", 1, 0)
table(df$FraudFound)
prop.table(table(df$FraudFound))
```

Step 2: Build label-neutral synthetic claim narratives
```{r}
make_narrative <- function(row) {
  paste(
    "Claim filed for a", row[["Make"]],
    row[["VehicleCategory"]], 
    "under", row[["BasePolicy"]], "policy.",
    "Accident area:", row[["AccidentArea"]], ".",
    "Driver age:", row[["Age"]], ".",
    "Driver sex:", row[["Sex"]], ".",
    "Marital status:", row[["MaritalStatus"]], ".",
    "Fault category:", row[["Fault"]], ".",
    "Claim amount:", row[["ClaimAmount"]], ".",
    "Vehicle price:", row[["VehiclePrice"]], ".",
    "Deductible:", row[["Deductible"]], ".",
    "Driver rating:", row[["DriverRating"]], ".",
    "Past claims:", row[["PastNumberOfClaims"]], ".",
    "Police report filed:", row[["PoliceReportFiled"]], ".",
    "Witness present:", row[["WitnessPresent"]], ".",
    "Agent type:", row[["AgentType"]], ".",
    "Number of supplements:", row[["NumberOfSuppliments"]], ".",
    "Address change claim:", row[["AddressChange.Claim"]], ".",   # ✅ FIXED
    "Number of cars:", row[["NumberOfCars"]], ".",
    "Month of accident:", row[["Month"]], ".",
    "Week of month:", row[["WeekOfMonth"]], ".",
    "Day of week:", row[["DayOfWeek"]], ".",
    "Month claimed:", row[["MonthClaimed"]], ".",
    "Week claimed:", row[["WeekOfMonthClaimed"]], ".",
    "Days policy accident:", row[["Days.Policy.Accident"]], ".",  # ✅ FIXED
    "Days policy claim:", row[["Days.Policy.Claim"]], "."         # ✅ FIXED
  )
}

df$claim_narrative <- apply(df, 1, make_narrative)

head(df$claim_narrative, 3)
```


Step 3: Train/test split BEFORE tokenization
```{r}
train_index <- createDataPartition(df$FraudFound, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train_df <- df[train_index, ]
test_df  <- df[-train_index, ]

y_train <- train_df$FraudFound
y_test  <- test_df$FraudFound

table(y_train)
table(y_test)
```

Step 4: Tokenize text using training set only
```{r}
library(keras3)

max_words <- 10000
max_len   <- 80

# Create vectorization layer
vectorizer <- layer_text_vectorization(
  max_tokens = max_words,
  output_mode = "int",
  output_sequence_length = max_len
)

# Learn vocabulary from TRAIN data ONLY
adapt(vectorizer, train_df$claim_narrative)

# Convert text → integer sequences
X_text_train <- vectorizer(train_df$claim_narrative)
X_text_test  <- vectorizer(test_df$claim_narrative)

# Convert tensors → arrays
X_text_train <- as.array(X_text_train)
X_text_test  <- as.array(X_text_test)

dim(X_text_train)
dim(X_text_test)
```
Step 5: Class weights for imbalance

```{r}
n_train <- length(y_train)
n_neg <- sum(y_train == 0)
n_pos <- sum(y_train == 1)

class_weights <- list(
  "0" = n_train / (2 * n_neg),
  "1" = n_train / (2 * n_pos)
)

class_weights
```
Step 6: Build LSTM model
```{r}
build_lstm_model <- function(max_words = 10000, max_len = 80, embedding_dim = 64, lstm_units = 32) {
  
  model <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
    layer_embedding(
      input_dim = max_words,
      output_dim = embedding_dim,
      input_length = max_len
    ) %>%
    layer_spatial_dropout_1d(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_lstm(units = lstm_units, dropout = 0.2, recurrent_dropout = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 16, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "sigmoid")
  
  model %>% compile(
    optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 0.001),
    loss = "binary_crossentropy",
    metrics = list(
      metric_precision(name = "precision"),
      metric_recall(name = "recall"),
      metric_auc(name = "auc")
    )
  )
  
  model
}

lstm_model <- build_lstm_model(max_words, max_len)
summary(lstm_model)
```
Step 7: Train model
```{r}
callbacks_list <- list(
  callback_early_stopping(
    monitor = "val_loss",
    patience = 4,
    restore_best_weights = TRUE
  ),
  callback_reduce_lr_on_plateau(
    monitor = "val_loss",
    factor = 0.5,
    patience = 2
  )
)

history <- lstm_model %>% fit(
  x = X_text_train,
  y = y_train,
  epochs = 15,
  batch_size = 256,
  validation_split = 0.2,
  class_weight = class_weights,
  callbacks = callbacks_list,
  verbose = 1
)

plot(history)
```

Step 8: Evaluate model
```{r}
y_pred_prob <- as.numeric(predict(lstm_model, X_text_test))
y_pred_class <- ifelse(y_pred_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0)

conf_mat <- confusionMatrix(
  factor(y_pred_class, levels = c(0,1)),
  factor(y_test, levels = c(0,1)),
  positive = "1"
)

print(conf_mat)

precision <- conf_mat$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
recall    <- conf_mat$byClass["Sensitivity"]
f1_score  <- 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

roc_obj <- roc(y_test, y_pred_prob)
roc_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))

pr_obj <- pr.curve(
  scores.class0 = y_pred_prob[y_test == 1],
  scores.class1 = y_pred_prob[y_test == 0],
  curve = TRUE
)

cat("Precision:", round(precision, 4), "\n")
cat("Recall:", round(recall, 4), "\n")
cat("F1 Score:", round(f1_score, 4), "\n")
cat("ROC-AUC:", round(roc_auc, 4), "\n")
cat("PR-AUC:", round(pr_obj$auc.integral, 4), "\n")
```

Step 10: Generate out-of-fold predictions for ensemble
```{r}
generate_lstm_oof <- function(texts, y, n_folds = 5, max_words = 10000, max_len = 80) {
  
  set.seed(456)
  folds <- createFolds(y, k = n_folds, list = TRUE)
  oof_pred <- numeric(length(y))
  
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    cat("Fold:", i, "\n")
    
    val_idx <- folds[[i]]
    tr_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(y), val_idx)
    
    tr_text <- texts[tr_idx]
    val_text <- texts[val_idx]
    y_tr <- y[tr_idx]
    
    # ✅ Create vectorizer for THIS fold
    vectorizer <- layer_text_vectorization(
      max_tokens = max_words,
      output_mode = "int",
      output_sequence_length = max_len
    )
    
    # ✅ Fit ONLY on training text
    adapt(vectorizer, tr_text)
    
    # ✅ Transform text → sequences
    X_tr  <- as.array(vectorizer(tr_text))
    X_val <- as.array(vectorizer(val_text))
    
    # Class weights
    n_tr <- length(y_tr)
    cw <- list(
      "0" = n_tr / (2 * sum(y_tr == 0)),
      "1" = n_tr / (2 * sum(y_tr == 1))
    )
    
    # Build model
    model <- build_lstm_model(max_words, max_len)
    
    # Train
    model %>% fit(
      X_tr, y_tr,
      epochs = 10,
      batch_size = 256,
      validation_split = 0.1,
      class_weight = cw,
      callbacks = list(
        callback_early_stopping(
          monitor = "val_loss",
          patience = 3,
          restore_best_weights = TRUE
        )
      ),
      verbose = 0
    )
    
    # Predict
    oof_pred[val_idx] <- as.numeric(predict(model, X_val))
  }
  
  return(oof_pred)
}
```

```{r}

summary(lstm_oof_predictions)
```
